📊 Best Bookkeeping & Invoicing Software for Contractors (2026)

Contractors need to send invoices fast, track job costs and hand clean books to an accountant at tax time. These are the bookkeeping tools in our directory that fit trades businesses, from free to full accounting.

FAQ

What is the best bookkeeping software for a small contractor?QuickBooks Online if you work with an accountant, since every accountant knows it. Wave if you want free. Xero if several people need logins, because it has unlimited users.
Is there free accounting software for contractors?Wave's Starter plan is $0 with no revenue cap. Payment processing fees are extra.
Do I still need bookkeeping software if I use Jobber or Housecall Pro?Usually yes. Field service apps handle quotes and invoices, but most contractors still sync into QuickBooks or Xero for full books. FieldEdge highlights a deep QuickBooks sync.
